narr: An isolated, slow moving thunderstorm developed over Albany with heavy rainfall in a short period of time. This led to flash flooding on several roads in the city.
ev: Dougherty County 911 reported several instances of flooding in Albany including W Highland Ave, 2nd Ave, S Davis St, an W Residence Ave.
